description: At most once by default (acknowledge before running); at least once for idempotent nodes and for LoadOptions, TestCredentials and Health (acknowledge after the reply). The core picks the mode; runners observe it through the core's delivery hook. Direct transports have one mode and skip the mode assertions.

cases.description: A node without `idempotent` is delivered at most once, even with an idempotency key.
A node marked `idempotent: true` is delivered at least once.
LoadOptions is always at least once (it has no side effects).

expect.note: the conformance plugin has no load-options methods; the reply may be a transport error not_found, the mode is what is asserted

cases.description: Health is always at least once.

Two calls with the same idempotency key are two calls: the transport does not deduplicate (the node forwards the key to its API; the host's own dedupe is per execution step). Both run; the second count is 2.
A redelivered event carries lfattempt 2 (or more); the first delivery carries 1. Runners that can force a redelivery (visibility timeout, nack) assert the attempt the plugin saw.

expect.note: lfattempt starts at 1; assert through the dispatcher hook when redelivery can be forced
